prompt: Create an original 180 second Chinese plucked-string ensemble instrumental composition for mystery, nocturnal exploration and restrained suspense. Mood: mysterious, tense, nocturnal. Instruments: pipa, yangqin, dizi, frame drum. Style: crisp plucked ostinato with bright bamboo-flute answers. Tempo approximately 96 BPM; G minor. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Use unresolved suspended harmony, careful space and subtle low-register movement; no jump scares. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A serene and traditional-sounding instrumental piece featuring plucked strings, a prominent flute-like melody, and light percussion. It evokes a peaceful and meditative atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首宁静而富有传统气息的纯器乐作品，以拨弦乐器、悠扬的笛子般旋律和轻柔的打击乐为主。营造出平和冥想的氛围。
